name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
December 9, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION
Pastor Tom Straeter, Grace Presbyterian Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Results of the November 4, 2014, General Municipal Election
P2.
Proclamation declaring Wednesday, December 10, 2014, to be "Councilman Dave Cowles Day" in the City of Vista, in recognition of his service to the community.
OATH OF OFFICE
PRESENTATIONS (CONTINUED)
P3.
Moonlight Cultural Foundation Presentation Supporting the Productions of 2014
CONSENT CALENDAR *Special Meeting Item C17 follows the last Regular Consolidated Consent Calendar item scheduled for this day and time.
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
C3.
2015 Scheduled Commission, Committee, and Board Vacancies (CC)
C4.
Moonlight Amphitheatre Man Lift Replacement and Acceptance of Funds from the Moonlight Cultural Foundation (CC)
C5.
Access Prohibition on Public Streets (CC)
C6.
Grant of Easement to San Diego Gas & Electric (SDG&E) and Declaration of Veterans Memorial Park Covenants (CDC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , granting an easement for electrical facilities to SDG&E, and authorizing the Chairperson to execute the easement.
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving a Declaration of Covenants, Conditions & Restrictions and authorizing the Chairperson to execute the declaration.
C7.
National Endowment for the Arts Our Town Grant Application (CC)
C8.
Acceptance of Fiscal Year 2014 State Homeland Security Program Grant Award (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , accepting grant funds of $70,688 and amending the FY 2014/15 Operating Budget; and
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving the FY 2014 grant assurances.
C9.
2015-2017 California Gang Reduction, Intervention, and Prevention Grant Award
(CalGRIP) (CC)
C10.
Encina Wastewater Authority Amended and Restated Revised Basic Agreement (RBA) for Ownership, Operation and Maintenance of a Joint Sewage System (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- .
C11.
Agreement with West Coast Arborists, Inc. for Street Tree Maintenance Services (CC)
C12.
Agreement for Sidewalk, Curb and Gutter Restoration Services (CC)
C13.
Agreement for Ownership, Operation, and Maintenance of the West Influent Pipeline (CC)
C14.
CIP No. 8232 - Approval of Utility Company Contracts (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving utility contracts with Pacific Bell Telephone Company dba AT&T California, Cox Communications California, LLC, and San Diego Gas & Electric Company for the Paseo Santa Fe project; and
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2014/15 Capital Improvement Program Budget.
C15.
2014 Regional Transportation Improvement Program (RTIP) Amendment and Audit Adjustments (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2013/14 TransNet Programming based on the end of year audit.
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , amending the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for FY 2015 through 2019.
C16.
Vista Chamber of Commerce (Chamber) Service Agreement for Grant Funds (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving an agreement for grant of public funds with the Chamber; and
C17.
Final Subdivision Map at 2019, 2021, and 2049 East Vista Way (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Appointment of Deputy Mayor (CC)
D2.
Appointments of Officials to Boards, Committees, and Commissions (CC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following resolutions of appointment:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , appointing a representative and an alternate representative to the Board of Directors of the North San Diego County Transit District Board (NCTD);
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , appointing a representative and first and second alternate representatives to the Board of Directors of the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG);
c.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , appointing a representative and an alternate representative to the Board of Directors of the Regional Solid Waste Association (RSWA);
d.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , appointing a representative and an alternate representative to the Board of Directors of the North County Dispatch Joint Powers Agency (North Comm);
e.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , appointing two representatives and two alternate representatives to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority; and
f.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- , appointing two representatives and two alternate representatives to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority.
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointments to the agencies not listed above, but shown on Exhibit 7.
3.
Direct staff to post the changes on the website on California Fair Political Practices Commission (FPPC) Form 806 in compliance with FPPC Regulation 18705.5.
PUBLIC HEARING
Recommended Action:
No Public Hearing items are scheduled. *3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
